segments.mn96:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
segments.mn96:2.1: Atha kho esukārī brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.
segments.mn96:2.2: Sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho esukārī brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn96:3.2: brāhmaṇassa pāricariyaṃ paññapenti, khattiyassa pāricariyaṃ paññapenti, vessassa pāricariyaṃ paññapenti, suddassa pāricariyaṃ paññapenti.
segments.mn96:3.3: Tatridaṃ, bho gotama, brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇassa pāricariyaṃ paññapenti –
segments.mn96:3.4: ‘brāhmaṇo vā brāhmaṇaṃ paricareyya, khattiyo vā brāhmaṇaṃ paricareyya, vesso vā brāhmaṇaṃ paricareyya, suddo vā brāhmaṇaṃ paricareyyā’ti.
segments.mn96:3.5: Idaṃ kho, bho gotama, brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇassa pāricariyaṃ paññapenti.
segments.mn96:3.6: Tatridaṃ, bho gotama, brāhmaṇā khattiyassa pāricariyaṃ paññapenti –
segments.mn96:3.7: ‘khattiyo vā khattiyaṃ paricareyya, vesso vā khattiyaṃ paricareyya, suddo vā khattiyaṃ paricareyyā’ti.
segments.mn96:3.8: Idaṃ kho, bho gotama, brāhmaṇā khattiyassa pāricariyaṃ paññapenti.
segments.mn96:3.9: Tatridaṃ, bho gotama, brāhmaṇā vessassa pāricariyaṃ paññapenti –
segments.mn96:3.10: ‘vesso vā vessaṃ paricareyya, suddo vā vessaṃ paricareyyā’ti.
segments.mn96:3.11: Idaṃ kho, bho gotama, brāhmaṇā vessassa pāricariyaṃ paññapenti.
segments.mn96:3.12: Tatridaṃ, bho gotama, brāhmaṇā suddassa pāricariyaṃ paññapenti –
segments.mn96:3.15: Idaṃ kho, bho gotama, brāhmaṇā suddassa pāricariyaṃ paññapenti.
segments.mn96:3.16: Brāhmaṇā, bho gotama, imā catasso pāricariyā paññapenti.
segments.mn96:4.1: “Kiṃ pana, brāhmaṇa, sabbo loko brāhmaṇānaṃ etadabbhanujānāti – ‘imā catasso pāricariyā paññapentū’”ti [paññapentīti (sī. ka.)]?
segments.mn96:4.3: “Seyyathāpi, brāhmaṇa, puriso daliddo [daḷiddo (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] assako anāḷhiyo. Tassa akāmassa bilaṃ olaggeyyuṃ – ‘idaṃ te, ambho purisa, maṃsaṃ khāditabbaṃ, mūlañca anuppadātabban’ti.
segments.mn96:4.4: Evameva kho, brāhmaṇa, brāhmaṇā appaṭiññāya tesaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ, atha ca panimā catasso pāricariyā paññapenti.
segments.mn96:5.1: Nāhaṃ, brāhmaṇa,‘sabbaṃ paricaritabban’ti vadāmi; nāhaṃ, brāhmaṇa,‘sabbaṃ na paricaritabban’ti vadāmi.
segments.mn96:5.2: Yaṃ hissa, brāhmaṇa, paricarato pāricariyāhetu pāpiyo assa na seyyo, nāhaṃ taṃ ‘paricaritabban’ti vadāmi;
segments.mn96:5.3: yañca khvāssa, brāhmaṇa, paricarato pāricariyāhetu seyyo assa na pāpiyo tamahaṃ ‘paricaritabban’ti vadāmi.
segments.mn96:6.2: ‘yaṃ vā te paricarato pāricariyāhetu pāpiyo assa na seyyo, yaṃ vā te paricarato pāricariyāhetu seyyo assa na pāpiyo;
segments.mn96:6.3: kamettha paricareyyāsī’ti, khattiyopi hi, brāhmaṇa, sammā byākaramāno evaṃ byākareyya –
segments.mn96:6.4: ‘yañhi me paricarato pāricariyāhetu pāpiyo assa na seyyo, nāhaṃ taṃ paricareyyaṃ; yañca kho me paricarato pāricariyāhetu seyyo assa na pāpiyo tamahaṃ paricareyyan’ti.
segments.mn96:7.4: ‘yaṃ vā te paricarato pāricariyāhetu pāpiyo assa na seyyo, yaṃ vā te paricarato pāricariyāhetu seyyo assa na pāpiyo;
segments.mn96:7.5: kamettha paricareyyāsī’ti, suddopi hi, brāhmaṇa, sammā byākaramāno evaṃ byākareyya –
segments.mn96:7.6: ‘yañhi me paricarato pāricariyāhetu pāpiyo assa na seyyo, nāhaṃ taṃ paricareyyaṃ; yañca kho me paricarato pāricariyāhetu seyyo assa na pāpiyo tamahaṃ paricareyyan’ti.
segments.mn96:7.7: Nāhaṃ, brāhmaṇa,‘uccākulīnatā seyyaṃso’ti vadāmi, na panāhaṃ, brāhmaṇa,‘uccākulīnatā pāpiyaṃso’ti vadāmi;
segments.mn96:7.8: nāhaṃ, brāhmaṇa,‘uḷāravaṇṇatā seyyaṃso’ti vadāmi, na panāhaṃ, brāhmaṇa,‘uḷāravaṇṇatā pāpiyaṃso’ti vadāmi;
segments.mn96:7.9: nāhaṃ, brāhmaṇa,‘uḷārabhogatā seyyaṃso’ti vadāmi, na panāhaṃ, brāhmaṇa,‘uḷārabhogatā pāpiyaṃso’ti vadāmi.
segments.mn96:8.1: “Uccākulīnopi hi, brāhmaṇa, idhekacco pāṇātipātī hoti, adinnādāyī hoti, kāmesumicchācārī hoti, musāvādī hoti, pisuṇāvāco hoti, pharusāvāco hoti, samphappalāpī hoti, abhijjhālu hoti, byāpannacitto hoti, micchādiṭṭhi hoti.
segments.mn96:8.3: Uccākulīnopi hi, brāhmaṇa, idhekacco pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti, adinnādānā paṭivirato hoti, kāmesumicchācārā paṭivirato hoti, musāvādā paṭivirato hoti, pisuṇāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti, pharusāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti, samphappalāpā paṭivirato hoti, anabhijjhālu hoti, abyāpannacitto hoti, sammādiṭṭhi hoti.
segments.mn96:8.5: “Uḷāravaṇṇopi hi, brāhmaṇa … pe … uḷārabhogopi hi, brāhmaṇa, idhekacco pāṇātipātī hoti … pe … micchādiṭṭhi hoti.
segments.mn96:8.11: Uḷārabhogopi hi, brāhmaṇa, idhekacco pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti … pe … sammādiṭṭhi hoti.
segments.mn96:9.1: Nāhaṃ, brāhmaṇa,‘sabbaṃ paricaritabban’ti vadāmi, na panāhaṃ, brāhmaṇa,‘sabbaṃ na paricaritabban’ti vadāmi.
segments.mn96:9.2: Yaṃ hissa, brāhmaṇa, paricarato pāricariyāhetu saddhā vaḍḍhati, sīlaṃ vaḍḍhati, sutaṃ vaḍḍhati, cāgo vaḍḍhati, paññā vaḍḍhati, tamahaṃ ‘paricaritabban’ti (vadāmi.
segments.mn96:9.3: Yaṃ hissa, brāhmaṇa, paricarato pāricariyāhetu na saddhā vaḍḍhati, na sīlaṃ vaḍḍhati, na sutaṃ vaḍḍhati, na cāgo vaḍḍhati, na paññā vaḍḍhati, nāhaṃ taṃ ‘paricaritabban’ti)[() etthantare pāṭho sī. syā. kaṃ. pī. potthakesu natthi] vadāmī”ti.
segments.mn96:10.1: Evaṃ vutte, esukārī brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn96:10.3: brāhmaṇassa sandhanaṃ paññapenti, khattiyassa sandhanaṃ paññapenti, vessassa sandhanaṃ paññapenti, suddassa sandhanaṃ paññapenti.
segments.mn96:10.4: Tatridaṃ, bho gotama, brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇassa sandhanaṃ paññapenti bhikkhācariyaṃ;
segments.mn96:10.5: bhikkhācariyañca pana brāhmaṇo sandhanaṃ atimaññamāno akiccakārī hoti gopova adinnaṃ ādiyamānoti.
segments.mn96:10.6: Idaṃ kho, bho gotama, brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇassa sandhanaṃ paññapenti.
segments.mn96:10.7: Tatridaṃ, bho gotama, brāhmaṇā khattiyassa sandhanaṃ paññapenti dhanukalāpaṃ;
segments.mn96:10.8: dhanukalāpañca pana khattiyo sandhanaṃ atimaññamāno akiccakārī hoti gopova adinnaṃ ādiyamānoti.
segments.mn96:10.9: Idaṃ kho, bho gotama, brāhmaṇā khattiyassa sandhanaṃ paññapenti.
segments.mn96:10.10: Tatridaṃ, bho gotama, brāhmaṇā vessassa sandhanaṃ paññapenti kasigorakkhaṃ;
segments.mn96:10.11: kasigorakkhañca pana vesso sandhanaṃ atimaññamāno akiccakārī hoti gopova adinnaṃ ādiyamānoti.
segments.mn96:10.12: Idaṃ kho, bho gotama, brāhmaṇā vessassa sandhanaṃ paññapenti.
segments.mn96:10.13: Tatridaṃ, bho gotama, brāhmaṇā suddassa sandhanaṃ paññapenti asitabyābhaṅgiṃ;
segments.mn96:10.14: asitabyābhaṅgiñca pana suddo sandhanaṃ atimaññamāno akiccakārī hoti gopova adinnaṃ ādiyamānoti.
segments.mn96:10.15: Idaṃ kho, bho gotama, brāhmaṇā suddassa sandhanaṃ paññapenti.
segments.mn96:10.16: Brāhmaṇā, bho gotama, imāni cattāri dhanāni paññapenti.
segments.mn96:11.1: “Kiṃ pana, brāhmaṇa, sabbo loko brāhmaṇānaṃ etadabbhanujānāti – ‘imāni cattāri dhanāni paññapentū’”ti?
segments.mn96:11.3: “Seyyathāpi, brāhmaṇa, puriso daliddo assako anāḷhiyo. Tassa akāmassa bilaṃ olaggeyyuṃ – ‘idaṃ te, ambho purisa, maṃsaṃ khāditabbaṃ, mūlañca anuppadātabban’ti.
segments.mn96:11.4: Evameva kho, brāhmaṇa, brāhmaṇā appaṭiññāya tesaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ, atha ca panimāni cattāri dhanāni paññapenti.
segments.mn96:12.1: Ariyaṃ kho ahaṃ, brāhmaṇa, lokuttaraṃ dhammaṃ purisassa sandhanaṃ paññapemi.
segments.mn96:12.2: Porāṇaṃ kho panassa mātāpettikaṃ kulavaṃsaṃ anussarato yattha yattheva attabhāvassa abhinibbatti hoti tena teneva saṅkhyaṃ gacchati.
segments.mn96:12.3: Khattiyakule ce attabhāvassa abhinibbatti hoti ‘khattiyo’ tveva saṅkhyaṃ gacchati;
segments.mn96:12.4: brāhmaṇakule ce attabhāvassa abhinibbatti hoti ‘brāhmaṇo’ tveva saṅkhyaṃ gacchati;
segments.mn96:12.5: vessakule ce attabhāvassa abhinibbatti hoti ‘vesso’ tveva saṅkhyaṃ gacchati;
segments.mn96:12.6: suddakule ce attabhāvassa abhinibbatti hoti ‘suddo’ tveva saṅkhyaṃ gacchati.
segments.mn96:12.7: Seyyathāpi, brāhmaṇa, yaṃyadeva paccayaṃ paṭicca aggi jalati tena teneva saṅkhyaṃ gacchati.
segments.mn96:12.8: Kaṭṭhañce paṭicca aggi jalati ‘kaṭṭhaggi’ tveva saṅkhyaṃ gacchati;
segments.mn96:12.9: sakalikañce paṭicca aggi jalati ‘sakalikaggi’ tveva saṅkhyaṃ gacchati;
segments.mn96:12.10: tiṇañce paṭicca aggi jalati ‘tiṇaggi’ tveva saṅkhyaṃ gacchati;
segments.mn96:12.11: gomayañce paṭicca aggi jalati ‘gomayaggi’ tveva saṅkhyaṃ gacchati.
segments.mn96:12.12: Evameva kho ahaṃ, brāhmaṇa, ariyaṃ lokuttaraṃ dhammaṃ purisassa sandhanaṃ paññapemi.
segments.mn96:12.13: Porāṇaṃ kho panassa mātāpettikaṃ kulavaṃsaṃ anussarato yattha yattheva attabhāvassa abhinibbatti hoti tena teneva saṅkhyaṃ gacchati.
segments.mn96:12.14: “Khattiyakule ce attabhāvassa abhinibbatti hoti ‘khattiyo’ tveva saṅkhyaṃ gacchati;
segments.mn96:12.15: brāhmaṇakule ce attabhāvassa abhinibbatti hoti ‘brāhmaṇo’ tveva saṅkhyaṃ gacchati;
segments.mn96:12.16: vessakule ce attabhāvassa abhinibbatti hoti ‘vesso’ tveva saṅkhyaṃ gacchati;
segments.mn96:12.17: suddakule ce attabhāvassa abhinibbatti hoti ‘suddo’ tveva saṅkhyaṃ gacchati.
segments.mn96:13.1: “Khattiyakulā cepi, brāhmaṇa, agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti, so ca tathāgatappaveditaṃ dhammavinayaṃ āgamma pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti, adinnādānā paṭivirato hoti, abrahmacariyā paṭivirato hoti, musāvādā paṭivirato hoti, pisuṇāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti, pharusāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti, samphappalāpā paṭivirato hoti, anabhijjhālu hoti, abyāpannacitto hoti, sammādiṭṭhi hoti, ārādhako hoti ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalaṃ.
segments.mn96:13.2: “Brāhmaṇakulā cepi, brāhmaṇa, agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti, so ca tathāgatappaveditaṃ dhammavinayaṃ āgamma pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti … pe … sammādiṭṭhi hoti, ārādhako hoti ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalaṃ.
segments.mn96:13.3: “Vessakulā cepi, brāhmaṇa, agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti, so ca tathāgatappaveditaṃ dhammavinayaṃ āgamma pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti … pe … sammādiṭṭhi hoti, ārādhako hoti ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalaṃ.
segments.mn96:13.4: “Suddakulā cepi, brāhmaṇa, agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti, so ca tathāgatappaveditaṃ dhammavinayaṃ āgamma pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti … pe … sammādiṭṭhi hoti, ārādhako hoti ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalaṃ.
segments.mn96:14.2: brāhmaṇova nu kho pahoti asmiṃ padese averaṃ abyābajjhaṃ mettacittaṃ bhāvetuṃ, no khattiyo no vesso no suddo”ti?
segments.mn96:14.4: Khattiyopi hi, bho gotama, pahoti asmiṃ padese averaṃ abyābajjhaṃ mettacittaṃ bhāvetuṃ;
segments.mn96:14.8: sabbepi hi, bho gotama, cattāro vaṇṇā pahonti asmiṃ padese averaṃ abyābajjhaṃ mettacittaṃ bhāvetun”ti.
segments.mn96:14.9: “Evameva kho, brāhmaṇa, khattiyakulā cepi agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti, so ca tathāgatappaveditaṃ dhammavinayaṃ āgamma pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti … pe … sammādiṭṭhi hoti, ārādhako hoti ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalaṃ.
segments.mn96:14.12: suddakulā cepi, brāhmaṇa, agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti, so ca tathāgatappaveditaṃ dhammavinayaṃ āgamma pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti … pe … sammādiṭṭhi hoti, ārādhako hoti ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalaṃ.
segments.mn96:15.2: brāhmaṇova nu kho pahoti sottisināniṃ ādāya nadiṃ gantvā rajojallaṃ pavāhetuṃ, no khattiyo no vesso no suddo”ti?
segments.mn96:15.4: Khattiyopi hi, bho gotama, pahoti sottisināniṃ ādāya nadiṃ gantvā rajojallaṃ pavāhetuṃ;
segments.mn96:15.8: sabbepi hi, bho gotama, cattāro vaṇṇā pahonti sottisināniṃ ādāya nadiṃ gantvā rajojallaṃ pavāhetun”ti.
segments.mn96:15.9: “Evameva kho, brāhmaṇa, khattiyakulā cepi agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti, so ca tathāgatappaveditaṃ dhammavinayaṃ āgamma pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti … pe … sammādiṭṭhi hoti, ārādhako hoti ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalaṃ.
segments.mn96:15.12: suddakulā cepi, brāhmaṇa, agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti, so ca tathāgatappaveditaṃ dhammavinayaṃ āgamma pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti … pe … sammādiṭṭhi hoti, ārādhako hoti ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalaṃ.
segments.mn96:16.2: idha rājā khattiyo muddhāvasitto nānājaccānaṃ purisānaṃ purisasataṃ sannipāteyya –
segments.mn96:16.3: ‘āyantu bhonto ye tattha khattiyakulā brāhmaṇakulā rājaññakulā uppannā sākassa vā sālassa vā salaḷassa vā candanassa vā padumakassa vā uttarāraṇiṃ ādāya aggiṃ abhinibbattentu, tejo pātukarontu;
segments.mn96:16.4: āyantu pana bhonto ye tattha caṇḍālakulā nesādakulā venakulā rathakārakulā pukkusakulā uppannā sāpānadoṇiyā vā sūkaradoṇiyā vā rajakadoṇiyā vā eraṇḍakaṭṭhassa vā uttarāraṇiṃ ādāya aggiṃ abhinibbattentu, tejo pātukarontū’”ti?
segments.mn96:16.6: yo evaṃ nu kho so khattiyakulā brāhmaṇakulā rājaññakulā uppannehi sākassa vā sālassa vā salaḷassa vā candanassa vā padumakassa vā uttarāraṇiṃ ādāya aggi abhinibbatto tejo pātukato so eva nu khvāssa aggi accimā ceva vaṇṇavā ca pabhassaro ca tena ca sakkā agginā aggikaraṇīyaṃ kātuṃ;
segments.mn96:16.7: yo pana so caṇḍālakulā nesādakulā venakulā rathakārakulā pukkusakulā uppannehi sāpānadoṇiyā vā sūkaradoṇiyā vā rajakadoṇiyā vā eraṇḍakaṭṭhassa vā uttarāraṇiṃ ādāya aggi abhinibbatto tejo pātukato svāssa aggi na ceva accimā na ca vaṇṇavā na ca pabhassaro na ca tena sakkā agginā aggikaraṇīyaṃ kātun”ti?
segments.mn96:16.9: Yopi hi so, bho gotama, khattiyakulā brāhmaṇakulā rājaññakulā uppannehi sākassa vā sālassa vā salaḷassa vā candanassa vā padumakassa vā uttarāraṇiṃ ādāya aggi abhinibbatto tejo pātukato svāssa aggi accimā ceva vaṇṇavā ca pabhassaro ca tena ca sakkā agginā aggikaraṇīyaṃ kātuṃ;
segments.mn96:16.10: yopi so caṇḍālakulā nesādakulā venakulā rathakārakulā pukkusakulā uppannehi sāpānadoṇiyā vā sūkaradoṇiyā vā rajakadoṇiyā vā eraṇḍakaṭṭhassa vā uttarāraṇiṃ ādāya aggi abhinibbatto tejo pātukato svāssa aggi accimā ceva vaṇṇavā ca pabhassaro ca tena ca sakkā agginā aggikaraṇīyaṃ kātuṃ.
segments.mn96:16.11: Sabbopi hi, bho gotama, aggi accimā ceva vaṇṇavā ca pabhassaro ca sabbenapi sakkā agginā aggikaraṇīyaṃ kātun”ti.
segments.mn96:16.12: “Evameva kho, brāhmaṇa, khattiyakulā cepi agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti, so ca tathāgatappaveditaṃ dhammavinayaṃ āgamma pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti … pe … sammādiṭṭhi hoti, ārādhako hoti ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalaṃ.
segments.mn96:16.15: suddakulā cepi, brāhmaṇa, agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti, so ca tathāgatappaveditaṃ dhammavinayaṃ āgamma pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti, adinnādānā paṭivirato hoti, abrahmacariyā paṭivirato hoti, musāvādā paṭivirato hoti, pisuṇāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti, pharusāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti, samphappalāpā paṭivirato hoti, anabhijjhālu hoti, abyāpannacitto hoti, sammādiṭṭhi hoti, ārādhako hoti ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalan”ti.
segments.mn96:17.1: Evaṃ vutte, esukārī brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn96:17.2: “abhikkantaṃ, bho gotama, abhikkantaṃ, bho gotama … pe …
segments.mn96:17.3: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan”ti.

lines: Tattha bilaṃ olaggeyyunti koṭṭhāsaṃ laggāpeyyuṃ, iminā satthadhammaṃ nāma dasseti.

Satthavāho kira mahākantārapaṭipanno antarāmagge goṇe mate maṃsaṃ gahetvā sabbesaṃ satthikānaṃ “idaṃ khāditvā ettakaṃ mūlaṃ dātabban”ti koṭṭhāsaṃ olaggeti, goṇamaṃsaṃ nāma khādantāpi atthi akhādantāpi, mūlaṃ dātuṃ sakkontāpi asakkontāpi.
Satthavāho yena mūlena goṇo gahito, tassa nikkhamanatthaṃ sabbesaṃ balakkārena koṭṭhāsaṃ datvā mūlaṃ gaṇhāti, ayaṃ satthadhammo.
Evamevaṃ brāhmaṇāpi lokassa paṭiññaṃ aggahetvā attanova dhammatāya catasso pāricariyā paññapentīti dassetuṃ evameva khotiādimāha.
Atha vā pāpiyoti pāpako lāmako attabhāvo assa.
Uccākulīnatā ca dvīsu kulesu vaḍḍheti khattiyakule brāhmaṇakule ca, uḷāravaṇṇatā tīsu.
Suddopi hi antamaso caṇḍālopi uḷārabhogo hotiyeva.
Bhikkhācariyanti koṭidhanenapi hi brāhmaṇena bhikkhā caritabbāva, porāṇakabrāhmaṇā asītikoṭidhanāpi ekavelaṃ bhikkhaṃ caranti.
Duggatakāle carantānaṃ idāni bhikkhaṃ carituṃ āraddhāti garahā na bhavissatīti.
Atimaññamānoti yo bhikkhācariyavaṃsaṃ haritvā sattajīvakasikammavaṇijjādīhi jīvikaṃ kappeti, ayaṃ atimaññati nāma.
Gopo vāti yathā gopako attanā rakkhitabbaṃ bhaṇḍaṃ thenento akiccakārī hoti, evanti attho.
Anussaratoti yattha jāto, tasmiṃ porāṇe mātāpettike kulavaṃse anussariyamāneti attho.
Laggāpeyyunti nhārunā vā vākena vā bandhitvā purisassa hatthe vā vasanagehe vā olambanavasena bandheyyuṃ.
Uccakulīnā dayo dutiyavārādīhi vuccanti, idha upadhivipattisampattiyo pāpiyādipadehi vuttāti adhippāyo.

“Vaṇṇo na khīyetha tathāgatassā”tiādīsu (dī. ni. aṭṭha.1.305;3.141; ma. ni. aṭṭha.2.425; udā.53; apa. aṭṭha.2.7.20; bu. vaṃ. aṭṭha.4.4; cariyā. aṭṭha.1. nidānakathā;2. pakiṇṇakakathā; dī. ni. ṭī.1. ganthārambhakathāvaṇṇanā; saṃ. ni. ṭī.1.2.1; a. ni. ṭī.1.1.1; vajira. ṭī. ganthārambhakathāvaṇṇanā; sārattha. ṭī.1. ganthārambhakathāvaṇṇanā; netti. ṭī. ganthārambhakathāvaṇṇanā; ma. ni. ṭī.1.1) viya vaṇṇa saddo idha pasaṃsāpariyāyoti āha “vessopi hi uḷāravaṇṇo hotī”ti.
“Niravo padasaddo soḷāragottassa akiṇṇamattikāpatto tiṭṭheyya asaṅgacārī”ti vuttattā bhikkhā caritabbāva, ayaṃ tesaṃ kuladhammoti adhippāyo.
Vividhaṃ bhāraṃ ābhañjanti olambanti etthāti byābhaṅgī, kājaṃ.

Uccanīcattajānanatthañca kulavavatthānaṃ kataṃ hotīti khattiyādikulakammunā tesaṃ catunnaṃ vaṇṇānaṃ sandhanaṃ jīvikaṃ paññapenti brāhmaṇā, tathāgato pana lokuttaradhammameva purisassa sandhanaṃ paññapeti tena sattassa lokaggabhāvasiddhito.

433-4. Maggānubodhoti maggapaṭipāṭiyā bodho bujjhanaṃ, yesaṃ kilesānaṃ samucchindanavasena maggappaṭivedho, tesaṃ paṭipassambhanavasena pavattamānaṃ sāmaññaphalaṃ, maggena paṭividdhāni saccāni, paramatthasaccameva vā anurūpabujjhananti adhippāyo.
Evañhi sati heṭṭhā vuttā saddhāpaṭilābhādayo dvādasa dhammā saccānuppattiyā upakārā honti, tasmā vuttaṃ “tesaṃyevāti heṭṭhā vuttānaṃ dvādasannan”ti.

Satipi kusalavipākādibhāvena nānatte vatthārammaṇabhūmikiccādivasena pana sadisāti upāyatova maggadhammā āsevitā bahulīkatā phalabhūtāti vattabbataṃ arahatīti taṃsadise tabbohāraṃ katvā “tesaṃ maggasampayuttadhammānan”ti vuttaṃ.
Na hi ekacittakkhaṇikānaṃ maggadhammānaṃ āsevanā, bahulīkammaṃ vā atthīti.
Sā hi vuṭṭhānagāminibhūtā maggappadhānassa bahukārā tassa abhāve maggappadhānasseva abhāvato, evaṃ ussāho tulanāya chando ussāhassa bahukārotiādinā heṭṭhimassa uparimūpakārataṃ suviññeyyamevāti āha –
